264143714_7094514b.text: SST O-LM cells projecting to the distal apical dendrites in the stratum lacunosum-moleculare

264143714_55a639cd.text: We observed SST-positive axons crossing the stratum radiatum in a perpendicular orientation and ramifying at the level of the stratum lacunosum-moleculare, both in the 4.1B KO mice (Figure 2J) as in the wild-type (Figure 2I). These particular SST axons are likely O-LM axons.
